scope: Follow-up to the real self-speech regression: assess restoring ordinary native spoken interruption without removing the installed echo guard.

baseline.nativeInput: 16 kHz mono PCM16; 20 ms packets, monotone sequence and bounded two-second receive queue.
baseline.nativeOutput: 24 kHz mono PCM16; existing wire confirms acceptance and FINISHED/STOPPED, not continuous DAC position.
baseline.availableProcessing: Installed local LiveKit WebRTC AudioProcessingModule; no new dependency or voice platform required for offline replay.

firmwareSourceChecked.scope: Retained primary-device wrapper and generated source, matching October installation manifest; not a fresh runtime DSP register read.
firmwareSourceChecked.channel0: AGC after AEC and noise suppression; native capture

delivered.default: Offline only, explicit local file paths, fixed public fixture hashes, fixed detector parameters, no audio saved.

softEarlyLinearEchoCase.withoutAutomaticGain: No confirmed speech start; clean reference starts at 3.200 seconds.
softEarlyLinearEchoCase.withAutomaticGain: First confirmed speech start at 7.200 seconds, four seconds later than the clean reference.

verification.checksMean: Measurements completed successfully; the candidate failed an essential soft-interruption condition. This is not a passing product test count.

conclusion: Do not enable this simple APM candidate or disable the existing native echo guard. Ordinary native spoken barge-in remains unresolved; separate wakeword/STOP/MUTE controls remain the installed route.
limits: The local Silero detector is a proxy, not the production listener or word-accuracy proof.
Synthetic delay, linear reverberation and clipping do not establish the actual device/room echo path or hardware AGC behavior.
Existing greeting warms the same APM state in the replay, but does not eliminate the soft-interruption failure.

Exploratory far16/near16 fixtures were not established as independent talkers. The retained harness uses separately pinned Alice/Bob active speech excerpts and avoids their original alternating silent regions.
Continuous DAC timing, first-word preservation, STOP races, reconnect and missing-reference handling were not implemented or verified in a production AEC adapter.
nextEvidenceGap: A coordinator-approved bounded physical comparison needs the actual render reference, captured signal and timing from one manually started authorized session. No reviewed passive paired-PCM exporter was established; the JSON protocol explicitly does not start capture or playback. Keep the production guard active until a concrete candidate passes.
privacy: No credentials, raw household audio/transcripts, private source IDs or device identifiers are included. Only public fixture hashes, installed synthetic greeting/model hashes and sanitized timings are published.
